calls.title: Scott & Ryan
calls.summary: The team discussed the sales forecast, with Scott Keller confirming a pipeline of approximately $1.85M, anchored by the Change.org deal, expected to close at 110% of quota. Quarterly quotas were outlined, with Scott's ramped targets set at $200K total and specific monthly goals. Deal engagement strategies, especially for the Ryanair deal, were reviewed, emphasizing personalized outreach and leveraging partnerships. The upcoming Anthropic press release was highlighted as a key differentiator to enhance credibility in sales conversations. Scott also developed a custom pipeline document for tracking deal statuses, and the importance of accurate forecasting and clear compensation structures was underscored.
calls.keywords: Sales Forecast, Pipeline Management, Travel Industry, Deal Engagement, Quota Ramp-up, Anthropic Partnership
calls.action_items:
**Scott Keller**
Update sales forecast to reflect 135k as committed revenue for current quarter (15:58)
Draft re-engagement emails for slow-moving and unresponsive prospects; send drafts to Ryan for review via Slack before sending out (29:47)
Utilize Anthropic partnership as a value lever in upcoming deal discussions to re-engage prospects, especially Ryanair and ups contacts (23:29)
Continue multi-threading efforts in key accounts and escalate to Ryan’s involvement once deals move past preliminary stages (24:12)

**Ryan McGurk**
Review Scott’s re-engagement email drafts and provide feedback on messaging tone and content via Slack (29:47)
Support Scott by leveraging Anthropic partnership announcements in conversations and, if needed, directly reach out to stalled prospects (22:41)
Coordinate with Jeff (forecast system builder) to provide additional training or walkthroughs on the forecast tool for Scott to ensure smoother pipeline management (15:14)
